note: Every client sets the session sql_mode to set on each MySQL connection it opens, after the driver's own setup, and a connection then reads @@SESSION.sql_mode as session, the server's order of the same modes (probe mysql.session.sql_mode_set). A case connects with ORM_TEST_MYSQL_DSN through the client's own connection setup and reads @@SESSION.sql_mode. docs/spec/config.md "Runtime connection" and docs/spec/dialects.md "Probe environment".
